utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina—before I lock anything in, can you confirm whether Rosa’s sign-up sheet matches Jules’s count of four volunteers from our block and three from the next?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Does Rosa’s sheet actually show seven total, or is one of Jules’s names still unconfirmed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’s exactly what I need to pin down—can we check Rosa’s sheet for whether it’s seven confirmed, or if one name is still tentative?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive, Dane—just tell me what needs fixing and when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Sam—can you meet us at the community shed at 9 and help with intake while we log each item and what repair it needs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Dane—I’ll be at the community shed at 9 and help with intake while you log everything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s set up by the community center, and Eli should have the schedule sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that with Eli first, Vik, and make sure the meeting spot’s actually the community center before I count on it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll check with Eli again, but I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s set up by the community center and he should have the schedule sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye—right now we’ve got about seven volunteers across both blocks, and most of the requests are bike tune-ups, small appliance fixes, and a couple of wobbly chairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds manageable—I can help Sunday at the community center as long as I work around school drop-off and pickup, so late morning or early afternoon should be fine for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Faye—late morning would be a big help, and I can slot you in where the rush is once school pickup’s sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Cleo, I still have the repair drive penciled in at the school parking lot after drop-off, but it’s only a placeholder until Faye confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal—Rosa moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so I’d update your note. I’m still tracking a sturdy ladder, a couple of hammers, and extra work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—I’ll mark Sunday at the community center as the current note, but I’m still treating it as provisional until Faye confirms the location.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m still fuzzy on the details, Quinn—I know the Martins signed up, and maybe one house on Oak, but I need to double-check before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—let’s not lock in the Oak house yet; I’ll just spread that the repair drive’s active and ask neighbors to send any repair needs or spare parts over this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s probably safest—I still need to confirm which Oak house it was, and I’m not sure on the start time either.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Leo, I’m sorting the signup list now, and by this afternoon I should have a clear schedule for the volunteers and repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—once you’ve got it, send me the schedule and I’ll match people to intake and the shed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works, Leo—I’ll send you the schedule this afternoon so you can line folks up for intake and the shed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, I heard the repair drive’s really coming together—people have been dropping off tools and spare parts, and Mara’s bringing a box of screws later too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds promising, but I still need to know who’s running intake and exactly where the drop-off table is going before I count on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven’t heard who’s handling intake yet, but Rosa’s gathering the repair needs and folks are pitching in, so I expect they’ll pin down the drop-off table spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in either way—I’ve heard community center, so I’d just plan on 10 Saturday and bring a few small tools unless Opal says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, 10 at the community center sounds right to me, and a few small tools would definitely help. I’ll be there early at the quiet check-in table for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—I’ll aim for 10 at the community center and look for you at check-in first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: There should be a few shared tools there, but if you’ve got a favorite or something specific, it’s helpful to bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I can stop by for a bit, and I’ll bring my gloves if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great—gloves are definitely useful, and even a short stop helps a lot. We’ll be at the community center starting at 10 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but it sounds like the repair drive’s coming together nicely. Send me the signup list when Eli has it, and I’ll see where I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s what I’ve heard too—I only know the bits going around, but Rosa’s collecting repair needs now, and I’ll send the signup list along once Eli has it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell—that helps. I’m still out on errands, so just send me the signup list when Eli has it and I’ll see where I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus — quick update, the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center; are you still available to help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can still make Sunday—I’ll bring my toolbox and ladder to the community center and help with the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Gus—thank you; I’ll put you down for Sunday at the community center with the toolbox and ladder for small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Faye—thank you; I’ve got you on the volunteer list for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll be sure to keep that school pickup window clear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me, as long as I stay clear of pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Faye—thank you; I’ll keep you scheduled around pickup and drop-off, and I’m glad to have you with us Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Dane, I’ve got community center at 10, so unless Mara says Maple changed, stick with the shed at 9 and I’ll wait for where they need hands most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—got it, I’ll stick with the shed at 9 for now and jump wherever they need me most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—I'll keep it simple and watch for Mara or Opal to confirm where they want us after that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard we’re still short a sturdy ladder and a couple of hammers, and if you remember the gloves that should help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks for the reminder; I’ll bring the gloves and check with Sam about that ladder and the hammers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot. If Sam can spare any extra work gloves too, Cleo said she’d note them down just in case.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks again, Uli—that early check-in help still makes a big difference, and I’ll bring the toolbox over when I arrive Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll keep the check-in table steady until you get there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Uli—I appreciate it, and I’ll head your way first thing with the toolbox so we can get folks sorted quickly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still uneasy about it, Eli—until someone confirms the intake person and the exact drop-off spot, I don’t want people showing up confused.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You’re right, Pia; I’ll confirm the intake person and the exact drop-off spot at the community center this afternoon, then I’ll send out the final schedule so nobody’s left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli—that would make me feel a lot better, especially if you can confirm who’s checking items in before anyone starts hauling tools over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, can you cover sorting tools and spare parts at the shed from 9? Dane’s on intake, so I need you keeping the tables organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—I can cover the shed from 9 and keep the tools and spare parts tables organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—please label anything unclaimed and flag me if the screws or hand tools start running low.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard secondhand updates, but Rosa’s collecting repair needs today, and Quinn said they’d spread the word this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, that’s me — I’m already telling folks to send any repair needs or spare parts over this afternoon, and I’ll keep Rosa in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve heard, so I’ll keep pointing people your way and pass anything along to Rosa too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on a couple of hammers and maybe that ladder, but Oren’s got the gloves covered for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds like it’s coming together—thanks for the update. I’m still out on errands, but send me the signup list when you can and I’ll see if I can help cover the hammers or ladder.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira—I’ll send the signup list over, and if you can cover either the hammers or the ladder, that’d fill one of the last big gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, is it still just three houses confirmed, and who’s officially handling the Saturday drop-off at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve heard about four volunteers from our block and three from the next one so far, and the community center’s handling the repair drive setup while folks sort tools and patch bikes there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it’s still three houses confirmed, then—who at the community center is our point person, and when will we have a final house count?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana — the repair drive starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center, and we’d be glad to have you if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — before I commit, can you remind me which houses have signed up already and what supplies we’re still missing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I know a few houses on Maple and the Ortiz place signed up, and we’re still short on extension cords, work gloves, and a couple of basic tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m still a little fuzzy on the details, Tess, but I’m supposed to help at the tool table at 10 on Saturday if that’s still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, yes, Noah—that’s still the plan, and the repair drive’s really coming together with folks dropping off tools and spare parts already.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—thanks, Tess. I was worried I’d mixed it up again, so I’ll stick with the tool table at 10 unless someone tells me otherwise.
